checks.criterion: Admin CMS diamankan dengan login email/password dan session cookie
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_auth.py
checks.evidence: POST /auth/login valid -> 200 + school_admin_session cookie; GET /auth/me -> 200; GET /admin/leads -> 200. POST /auth/login wrong password -> 401. GET /admin/leads and /admin/content/news without cookie -> 401.

checks.criterion: Admin CMS diamankan dengan login email/password dan session cookie
checks.name: admin-login-flow
checks.evidence: Wrong password kept admin-login-page visible with error toast; correct credentials opened admin-dashboard with admin-leads-heading visible. Screenshot captured.

checks.criterion: Admin dapat mengelola berita, agenda, galeri, dan jurusan tanpa mengubah kode
checks.name: test_tscheck_cms_crud.py
checks.evidence: Parametrized over news/agenda/gallery/major: POST /admin/content -> 201, PATCH /admin/content/{id} (title+is_published) -> 200, GET /admin/content/{resource} lists it, DELETE -> 200 and item absent afterwards. POST /admin/content without session -> 401.

checks.criterion: Admin dapat mengelola berita, agenda, galeri, dan jurusan tanpa mengubah kode
checks.name: admin-cms-crud
checks.evidence: Created tscheck-news-* item via admin editor, verified it appeared on public agenda section, edited title+unpublished, then deleted it; all steps reflected in UI (4 screenshots).

checks.criterion: Konten yang diterbitkan dari CMS tampil di website publik
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_content.py
checks.evidence: GET /content/gallery after creating one published + one unpublished tscheck item returned only the published id; is_published true for every returned row.

checks.criterion: Konten yang diterbitkan dari CMS tampil di website publik
checks.name: admin-cms-crud
checks.evidence: Same admin-cms-crud check: newly created published news item was visible on the public agenda section after navigating to '/', confirming CMS-to-public visibility.
